model.threshold_basis: quantiles of the scores of all areas of a similar administrative level
model.reference: same +/-15-day calendar window in the other years, 2003 onwards

note: Anomalies describe observed activity that departs from the area's own history for that time of year. They are computed on the harmonized series and are not forecasts.
